description: Most passes start around the halfway line and in the opponent's half, with many clustered in the middle and right-center areas and a few starting deep on the left. The arrows are a mix of short and medium lengths, pointing in various directions, with many going backward or sideways and some forward. Carries are spread across the pitch, with many in the middle and attacking half and several ending near the right third. The 12 shots come from the right side near and outside the penalty area, with one large circle close to goal and one goal.

Most passes start in the left half and around the halfway line, mainly in the lower (bottom) part of the pitch. Arrows are a mix of short and medium lengths, with some pointing forward and many pointing up or back toward the left. A few longer passes go toward the right side, and some of those are incomplete. The carries are short and sit in the left half and around the centre, with none visibly reaching the right third. There are no shots.

Passes start mostly in the left half and the middle of the pitch, with a cluster in the lower-left area. Many arrows are medium to long and point right or diagonally forward. A few red incomplete passes run to the far right edge. Carries are mostly in the middle and lower half of the pitch, and most are short. Only a few reach the right third. Five shots come from inside or just outside the box, one of them a goal.

Most passes start in the left half and around the halfway line, with many arrows pointing right and upfield. Lengths vary from short to several long diagonal balls, and a few red incomplete passes go toward the right half. Carries are small and clustered in the own half and around the centre circle, with almost none reaching the final third. There is one shot, a goal from very close in front of goal.

Passes start mostly around the middle of the pitch and in the left-centre area, with many crossing the halfway line, and a handful begin in the right third. Arrows go in many directions, both forward and back, and most are short to medium with a few long ones. Carries are spread across the pitch with mostly short arrows, and few begin before the final third and end inside it. The 3 shots are all taken from close to the edge of the box, with no goals.

Passes start across the pitch but are heavily concentrated in the top (upper) half and the middle and right areas, with many arrows pointing right toward the opponent's goal. Many are long, and a good number of the incomplete red passes end near the right end line and the box. Carries are spread mostly along the upper side and middle, with many short to medium arrows, and several run from the middle into the right third. There are 7 shots, 1 of them a goal. They are mostly from the right side of the pitch, in or just outside the box, with one large high-quality shot near the penalty spot.

Passes (14 total, 13 complete) start mostly around the halfway line and in the opponent's half, with several short arrows pointing up, back or sideways and one red incomplete pass heading toward the right side of the pitch. Most arrows are short to medium length. The 11 carries are mostly short, scattered through the middle and right; one long carry runs from the centre-left to the right and a few short ones reach near the right edge. All 6 shots are clustered tightly very close to goal, inside the six-yard area.

Passes start mostly from the lower (bottom) side of the pitch, spread from the own half through the middle and into the right third. Many arrows point forward and are short to medium in length, with a few red incomplete ones near the opponent's box. Carries are mostly short and clustered in the lower middle and right-middle areas, with one long carry across the pitch toward the right edge of the box. Two shots are shown, both taken from close inside the box with no goals.

Passes start mostly in the middle and upper part of the pitch, with many starting around the halfway line and the right-hand side. Many are long arrows going forward toward the opponent's box, and a good number of the red incomplete ones end near the box. Carries are mostly in the middle and attacking half, often pointing right, with several ending in the final third. The four shots are all close to the penalty area, with one larger circle central and no goals.

Passes start mostly in the own half and around the centre circle, with many arrows pointing up the pitch and diagonally; a few long red ones go toward the right side. Most completed passes are short to medium, with a handful of long diagonals. Carries are mostly short and scattered in the middle and defensive areas, with only a few near the right third. Five shots all come from close, inside or at the edge of the box on the right, none of them goals.

Most passes start in the lower (bottom) part of the pitch, many from the right-hand side around the middle and the own half edge, and many arrows point forward toward the right-side box and byline. Several long red and green passes go into the opponent's box, with a mix of shorter passes along the way. Carries are clustered in the bottom half of the pitch from the middle to the final third, many pointing right. Seven shots come from around the edge of the box and just outside it, with one goal near the penalty spot.

Passes start across both halves, with many in the middle and the right side of the pitch. Many arrows point backward or sideways, and the red incomplete passes cluster near the right edge by the opponent box. Most arrows are short to medium. The 30 carries are mostly short and spread across the middle, with a few longer ones heading right toward the final third. One shot is drawn, taken from close to the right of the box edge.

Passes start mostly in the left half and central areas, around the middle of the pitch, with a spread of green completed arrows and some red incomplete ones, including a few long diagonals toward the right side. Arrows point in many directions, some forward, many sideways or backward, and most are short to medium in length. Carries are clustered around the centre circle and middle of the pitch, are mostly short, and few end inside the right third. The shots panel is empty, with 0 shots.

Passes mostly start around the halfway line and in the right half, concentrated along the top (one) side of the pitch, with many arrows pointing back or across toward the middle and some going forward toward the box; a few red incomplete ones are near the right end. Pass arrows are mostly short to medium. Carries are short and cluster in the right half on the top side, with several running toward the right end of the pitch, while a few small ones sit on the left. There is only one shot, a goal from close range inside the box.

Passes start mostly in the left half and the middle of the pitch, with a dense cluster of green arrows around the own box and centre circle. Many arrows are medium to long and run in several directions, including some forward and some back toward the left, and a few red incomplete passes go far toward the right. Carries are concentrated in the middle and left-centre areas, mostly short, with very few reaching the right third. The four shots are all clustered close to goal inside the box, with no goals.

Passes start mostly in the left half and around the centre circle, with a few starting just past halfway. Most arrows point forward or diagonally right, and they are a mix of short and medium lengths, with a few longer ones, some of them incomplete, going toward the right side. Carries are short and sit around the centre of the pitch and the own half, with none reaching the right third. There is one shot, a goal, taken from inside the box close to the goal.

Most passes start in the left half and the upper (top) part of the pitch, with many short and medium arrows pointing in different directions, plus a few longer red incomplete ones heading toward the right side. Carries are mostly short and spread across the top half and the middle, with a few at the bottom, and very few begin before and end inside the right third. There is only one shot, taken from outside the box in front of goal.

Passes start across the pitch, with many in the middle and right-hand portions, and a cluster of incomplete red passes near the opponent's box. Most arrows point rightward, and the lengths vary from short to fairly long diagonals. Carries are concentrated on the lower right side, where several start before the final third and end inside it, and the 6 shots are all close to goal inside or at the edge of the box, with no goals.

Passes start mostly around the middle of the pitch and the right half, with a handful in the final third. Many arrows point back or left, with a few forward ones, and lengths are a mix of short and medium with a couple of long diagonals. Carries are mostly short and scattered through the middle and attacking half, with only a couple of longer runs. All 8 shots are clustered close to goal inside the box, and one is a goal.

Passes start mostly in the left half and around the centre circle, with a spread of arrows going both forward and back or sideways. Most arrows are short to medium, with a few longer diagonals; 45 are complete and 6 incomplete. Carries are short and clustered in the middle of the pitch, with very few reaching the right third. No shots are drawn.

Passes start mostly in the lower part of the pitch, from about the middle to the right side, with many starting in the opponent half and some near the right-hand box. Arrows are a mix of short and medium lengths. Many point forward or diagonally toward the right, though some go back or left, and a good number of red incomplete passes sit near the opponent box. Carries are concentrated in the right half along the bottom edge, with several running from the middle into the final third. Two shots are drawn, both close together very near the goal line on the right side.

Passes start mostly in the right half, especially the lower (bottom) side of the pitch and in and around the final third. Many arrows are short to medium and point forward or toward the box. A cluster of red incomplete passes sits near the opponent's box and byline. Carries are concentrated in the right half along the bottom side, with several running into the final third. Five shots are all inside or just outside the box, and one is a goal.

Passes start mostly around the middle of the pitch and across both halves, with many starting near the halfway line and in the central and left-centre areas. Many arrows point right, and there are many long and medium passes, including long diagonals and cross-field balls, with a good number of red incomplete ones in the middle and attacking half. Carries are spread around the middle and the opponent's half, mostly short, and only a few end deep in the right third; the 5 shots are all taken from just outside the box, central, with no goals.

Passes start mostly in the middle band of the pitch, around the centre circle and the left half, with a dense cluster of green arrows. Many arrows point forward and are medium to long, with a few red incomplete passes reaching toward the right-hand box. Carries are short and concentrated around the centre and own half, with almost none ending in the final third. There is a single shot, taken from very close to the right goal line, off to one side.

Passes start mostly in the left half and around the centre circle, with many arrows pointing right and a number of red incomplete ones in the middle and towards the right. Most arrows are short to medium, with a few longer ones. Carries are clustered around the middle of the pitch, mostly short, and few reach the right third. No shots are drawn.

Passes start mostly in the lower (bottom) part of the pitch, with a dense cluster around the middle and right-of-centre bottom area, and many arrows point back or sideways toward the left and up. Some red incomplete passes sit near the opponent's box on the right. Carries are mostly short, concentrated in the bottom-right half, with several running toward the opponent's end, and the 6 shots are all from inside or just outside the box, including 2 goals.

Passes start mostly in the left half and around the middle of the pitch, with many arrows pointing right and a lot of long ones crossing much of the pitch. Several red incomplete passes end in the attacking third. Carries are clustered in the own half and middle, mostly short, with only a few reaching the right third. No shots are drawn.

Most passes start in the right half and many are in the final third. They are short to medium, and many point sideways or back, with a few going forward. One long red pass starts near the centre circle and goes toward the box. Carries are spread around the middle and right side, and several start before the final third and end inside it. All 5 shots are close to goal, in or around the box, with no goals.

Only two passes are drawn, both completed and short, starting around the halfway line and just inside the opponent's half; one goes forward and right, the other goes slightly down the pitch. There are three short carries: one longer diagonal run from near halfway toward the right-hand third, and two very small ones near the penalty area. Three shots are drawn, all from close inside the box or near the goal line, one of them large (high quality) and none scored.

Passes start mostly in the middle and upper part of the pitch, from around the halfway line into the right-hand third, with many arrows in the top (wide) channel. Most are short to medium, with several pointing right toward the box (some incomplete, in red, near the penalty area) and others pointing back or down. Carries begin mostly around the middle and right half, with a number ending in or near the final third and box. There are 6 shots, all from inside or near the box, including one goal.

Passes mostly start along the bottom touchline, from the own half through the middle and into the right third. Many arrows point forward and across the pitch, with a mix of short and medium lengths and a few long diagonals. Carries cluster along the bottom wing, and several run from the middle into the final third. There is only one shot, taken from a wide, tight angle on the goal line.

Passes start mostly in the left half, around the own penalty area and the central and upper areas, with many going forward and across the pitch. Many arrows are long, including diagonal balls toward the right side and some incomplete ones into the final third. Carries are mostly in the own half and the middle, with a few reaching the right third on the upper side. There are no shots.

Passes start mostly along the lower (bottom) side of the pitch, spread from the own half into the final third, with a dense cluster of arrows, many of them red, near the right-hand box. Most arrows point rightward and many are medium to long. Carries are concentrated in the lower half of the pitch, with several running from the middle into the right third. There is a single low-quality shot from close on the right side of the box.

Passes start mostly in the left half and around the middle of the pitch, with a dense cluster between the own box and the halfway line. Most arrows point right, and many are medium to long. A few red incomplete passes go toward the right side. Carries are concentrated in the middle and left-middle areas, mostly short, with only a few long ones reaching toward the right third. There are 3 shots, all from close range inside the box, with fairly large circles and no goals.

Most passes start along the bottom side of the pitch, in the own half and around the middle, and many arrows point right, with some long diagonal balls toward the top and the final third. A few passes start in the right third, and most red incomplete passes are in the same bottom area. Carries are mostly in the bottom half of the pitch from the own half to just past halfway, with only a few ending inside the right third. There are 4 shots, all very close to goal at the right edge of the six-yard box, and 2 of them are goals.

Passes start mostly in the left half and the middle of the pitch, with a dense cluster in the defensive and central areas. Many arrows point right and some are long, reaching across the pitch toward the final third, with a fair number of red incomplete ones. Carries are concentrated in the own half and around the centre circle, are mostly short, and few end in the right third. There are 7 shots, all bunched very close to goal inside the box, with one goal.

Passes start mostly in the own half and around the halfway line, with a dense cluster in the left-centre of the pitch. Many arrows point right and upfield, and several are long, including some red incomplete ones heading toward the final third. Carries are mostly short and sit in the middle of the pitch, and few reach the final third. The four shots are all close to goal, inside or at the edge of the box, with none scoring.

Passes start mostly in the own half and around the halfway line, concentrated in the upper (top) part of the pitch. Many arrows are long and point forward or diagonally across the pitch, with a fair number of incomplete ones (red) heading toward the top and right. Carries are clustered in the own half, mostly in the upper area, and none clearly end inside the final third. There is a single shot, a goal from close range inside the box.

Most passes start in the left half and the middle of the pitch, mainly along the top (upper) side. Many arrows point right, and there is a mix of short and medium lengths with a few long diagonal ones. The carries are mostly in the upper half of the pitch and the middle, with a few that end in the right third. There are 3 shots, all from close inside or near the box, and one of them is a goal.

Passes mostly start around the halfway line and in the opponent's half, with many in the right-hand third. Arrows are a mix of short and medium lengths, and many point back or sideways as well as forward. A cluster of carries runs along the bottom edge into the final third, with others in the middle. All 11 shots, including 2 goals, are taken from inside or right next to the box.

Passes start mostly around the middle of the pitch and in the opponent's half, with a spread of arrows pointing both forward and back or sideways. Many are medium to long, including one long completed ball from the left half across the centre circle, and a lot of them are incomplete (17 of 26). Carries are few and short, scattered around the middle and a couple near the right edge, with only one or two reaching the final third. The four shots all come from inside or right next to the box, and two of them are goals.

Passes start mostly around the middle of the pitch, with many in the central and right-of-centre areas. Many arrows point to the right and some are long, while a cluster of red incomplete passes sits near the opponent's box and the right edge. Carries are spread over the pitch, mostly in midfield, and only a few clearly end in the final third. There are 7 shots, all from the right side of the pitch, inside or near the box. None are goals.

Nearly all passes start in the team's own defensive half, mostly in the left-center area near the penalty box and the halfway line. Many arrows point forward or diagonally, and lengths are mixed, with several medium and some long ones. Carries are clustered in the own half and around the middle, and few reach the right third. There are 3 shots, all from very close in front of goal, and one is a goal.

Most passes start around the halfway line and in the opponent's half, with many clustered between the centre circle and the edge of the box. Arrows are a mix of short and medium lengths, with several pointing right toward goal and a number pointing back or sideways. Carries are concentrated in the right half, with several starting before and ending in the final third. There are 3 shots, one large high-quality shot from near the penalty spot and two small ones from just outside the box.

Passes start from a mix of areas: several from the bottom (right-hand side) of the own half and many from the lower right edge near the opponent's box, where a cluster of long red and green arrows point up toward the box. Many arrows are long, running up the pitch or diagonally, and a few go back or sideways toward the left. Carries are spread across the pitch, mostly short to medium and with several along the bottom edge heading right, but few clearly end inside the final third. There are 3 shots, all from close to or inside the box, one large and two small.

Passes start mostly along the top touchline, with many beginning in the left half and middle of the pitch. Many arrows point right or diagonally down the pitch, and several are long, including a few that reach the right-hand box. Carries are spread across the top half of the pitch, mostly in the left and middle areas. A few are long, and only some end near the right third. There is one shot, taken from central and fairly far out, with no goal.

Passes (22 complete, 12 incomplete) mostly start around the halfway line and in the central-right part of the pitch, with a cluster just inside the opponent half; many arrows point forward or up and down the pitch, and several are short to medium with a few red incomplete ones near the box. Carries (32) are mostly in the opponent half, with several short arrows pointing toward the box and one long carry running from the left side to near the edge of the box. All 8 shots are clustered inside or right at the edge of the penalty area, with no goals, and several are large circles showing higher quality chances.

Passes start across the whole pitch, with a good number in the left half and many more around the middle and the right side. Arrows point in many directions, forward and back, and most are short to medium with a few long diagonal balls. Carries are mostly short and spread over the pitch, with only a few ending in the right third. The 5 shots are all clustered close to goal, inside or at the edge of the box, with no goals.

Passes start mostly in the left half and the middle of the pitch, along the upper (top) side. Most arrows are short to medium and point to the right. A few longer red incomplete passes go toward the opponent's box. Carries are mostly short and sit in the top half, with a few reaching the right side of the pitch. The shots panel is empty, with 0 shots.

Passes mostly start in the right half and the lower (right-wing) side of the pitch. Many begin in the final third, with a cluster near the bottom right and some from the corner. Most arrows point forward or toward the box, and lengths vary from short to medium, with a few long ones back toward the left. Carries are concentrated in the right half along the bottom, with several running into the final third. The 6 shots with no goals all come from the right side near or inside the box, and one is larger than the rest.

Passes start mostly in the left and middle of the pitch, with many green arrows around the centre circle and own half, and a smaller number of passes starting in the right third; many of the red incomplete passes are in the opposition half. Passes are a mix of short and medium arrows, with some long diagonals going forward and many pointing back or sideways. Carries are spread around the middle, with several long arrows through the central areas and few ending inside the right third. There is one shot, from close to the right-hand edge of the box, and no goals.

Passes start mostly along the bottom side of the pitch, spread from the own half into the final third. Many arrows are short to medium and point forward or diagonally, with a few long red incomplete balls going toward the top right. Carries are mostly short and on the bottom side, with several in the right third. Two shots, both from close inside or near the box on the right.

Passes start across the whole pitch, with many in the middle and near the right-hand side. Lots of them are medium to long arrows, and several long red ones are incomplete. Directions are mixed, with some arrows pointing right and many pointing back or across. The 67 carries are mostly short and spread over the pitch, with a cluster in the lower right near the box and only a few long ones heading toward the right third. There is one shot, from just outside the box on the right, so shots are few.

Passes mostly start around the halfway line and in the central and left-of-centre areas. Many arrows point back or sideways toward the left, with a few forward passes, and a cluster of passes starts around the centre circle and goes into the right half. Pass lengths vary from short to medium, with a few long ones. Carries are few and short, mostly near the middle of the pitch, and none clearly start before and end inside the right third. There are no shots.

Passes start mostly around the halfway line and in the own half, with several short and medium arrows pointing back or sideways, plus a few in the opponent's right-hand area near the box, some of them incomplete. Carries are scattered across the pitch, with a few longer ones heading toward the right third, such as one from the middle crossing into the final third. Three shots, none scored, all come from close to or inside the box.

Passes start across the pitch, with many from the middle and the lower (bottom) side. Many arrows point right and upward toward the opponent's box, and several are long diagonals, with a good number of the red incomplete ones among them. Carries are mostly in the bottom half and middle of the pitch, with a number of longer arrows running right into the final third. There are 2 shots, both from very close to goal inside the box: one large high-quality circle and one small one.

Passes (44 complete, 18 incomplete) mostly start in the right half and many begin in the attacking third, especially on the lower (bottom) side and near the right edge of the box. Many arrows point forward or toward the box and are short to medium, with a few longer balls from the left half; several red incompletions occur near the box. Carries (61) are concentrated in the right half and the final third, many ending near the box, and the 4 shots are all clustered close together just inside the penalty area, with none scoring.

Nearly all passes start deep in the left part of the pitch, around the own penalty area, and fan out toward the right and across the pitch. Many arrows are long, reaching the middle of the pitch and beyond, and a fair number of the long ones are red (incomplete). The 93 carries are clustered inside and just outside the own penalty area and are short, with none reaching the final third. No shots are drawn.

Passes start mostly along the bottom side of the pitch, from the left half through the middle and into the right third, with a cluster of red and green arrows near the opponent's box. Most arrows are short to medium, with a few long red ones sent forward, and many point to the right. Carries are mostly short and sit in the lower half of the pitch across the middle, with one long carry from the left half toward the centre. Only one shot is shown, from close range inside the box.

Passes start mostly along the bottom (one) side of the pitch, from deep in the own half through midfield and into the right third, with many arrows pointing right and a good number going into or near the box. Most arrows are medium to long, and there are quite a few red incomplete ones near the opponent's box. Carries are clustered along the bottom touchline, mostly in the middle and own half, with only a few reaching the right third. There are 4 shots, all taken from just outside or at the edge of the box on the right side, none scored.

Passes start from across the pitch, with many in the middle and in the right third near the opponent's box, and a few in the left half. Most arrows are short to medium, and many point forward or down toward the right-hand side. Several red incomplete passes sit near the box. Carries are mostly short and scattered through the middle and right half, with only a few that start before the final third and end inside it. There is one shot, taken from close range inside the box, and it did not score.

Passes mostly start in the lower (bottom) part of the pitch, from the own half through to the right side. Many arrows point forward and end near the right edge and the box, and a cluster of red incomplete passes sits near the opponent's goal line and corner. Most arrows are short to medium, with a few long ones across the pitch. Carries are concentrated along the bottom flank and in the right half, and several run into the final third. The 6 shots, with no goals, are all taken from close to or inside the box.

Nearly all passes start in the left half and around the halfway line, and most are completed (57 complete, 1 incomplete). Many arrows are medium to fairly long, pointing forward and diagonally, and one very long red pass goes from deep in the own half to the opponent's box. The 45 carries are clustered in the own half and around the centre circle, and they are mostly short. A few go forward, and none clearly end in the final third. No shots are drawn.

Passes start mostly in the left and middle of the pitch, with a dense cluster across the upper (top) half and many arrows pointing right toward the opponent's half; a number of red incomplete passes sit near the top edge and the right side. Many arrows are medium to long, stretching across a large part of the pitch. Carries are concentrated in the upper half, mostly around the middle and into the right third, with a few reaching the right edge area. Two shots are drawn, both close to the box edge on the right, with no goals.

Passes start mostly along the top touchline, from the own half through the middle of the pitch. Many go forward or diagonally toward the right, and several incomplete ones end near the opponent's box. Lengths vary from short to medium, with a few long ones. The 39 carries are mostly short and sit in the top strip around the halfway line and the right half. Only one shot is drawn, from the right side, just outside the box.

Passes start mostly around the middle and right-hand side of the pitch, with many starting in the opponent's half and a cluster near the right edge and box. Arrows are a mix of short and medium lengths, with many pointing right and a good number pointing left or back, and a fair number of red incomplete ones near the opponent's goal. Carries are spread over the middle and right half, with several running from the halfway area into the final third. There are 5 shots, all close to goal inside or near the box, and 3 of them are goals.

Passes start mostly along the top touchline side and across the middle and right-of-centre of the pitch, with many arrows pointing right toward the opponent's end; some are long diagonals and switches, while most are short to medium. A few red incomplete passes cluster near the opponent's box. Carries sit mostly along the top edge in the middle and right half, with many short arrows and some that reach the right third. Five shots are all from close, inside or right at the edge of the box, and one is a goal.

Passes are spread across the whole pitch, with many starting in the middle and the left half and a good number reaching the right half. Most arrows are short to medium, with a few longer diagonals, and the red incomplete ones cluster near the opponent's box on the right. Carries are scattered over the pitch, mostly short, with a few longer ones in the middle and lower channels. There are 2 shots, both from just inside the right edge of the box, wide of centre.

Passes start mostly in the left half and around the middle of the pitch. Many arrows point sideways, back or diagonally, and a few point forward. Most are short to medium, with a handful of longer red incomplete ones. Carries are short and scattered across the pitch, with few ending in the right third. There are 2 shots, both from inside the box close to goal, and one is a goal.

Passes start mostly in the left half and the area around the halfway line, with a dense cluster of green arrows in the defensive and middle thirds. Many arrows point right and are medium to long, and several red incomplete ones reach toward the final third. Carries are concentrated in the own half and middle of the pitch, with almost none ending in the right third. There are 4 shots, mostly from close to the box, though one comes from farther out, and none are goals.

Nearly all passes start in the team's own defensive third, clustered near the left goal. They fan out forward and across the pitch. Many are long, reaching the halfway line and beyond, and a lot of the long ones are red (incomplete), while the shorter ones near the start are mostly green. The 86 carries are all bunched inside the left penalty area and the area just outside it, and they are short. None reach the right third. No shots are drawn (0 shots).

Passes start mostly around the middle of the pitch, from just inside the own half through the centre circle and into the area before the box, with a few from the right corner area. Most arrows are short to medium, with a few long red incomplete ones from the right edge heading back or across. Carries are short and spread around the middle and right side, with several small ones near the edge of the box. Three shots, none scored, all from close in or near the box.

Passes start mostly around the middle of the pitch and the opponent's half, with a dense cluster near and inside the opponent's box. Many arrows point forward, and the incomplete red passes, including several long ones, are concentrated near the box and the right edge. Most passes are short to medium. Carries are spread across the middle and right half, and several run into the final third. There is only one shot, from close range inside the box, and it isn't a goal.

Passes start mostly in the left half and around the halfway line, with many green short and medium arrows pointing in various directions. A group of long red incomplete passes runs from the middle of the pitch toward the right end near the opponent's box. Carries are spread across the own half and the centre, mostly short and often pointing down or sideways, with very few ending in the right third. There is only one shot, taken from well outside the box, around the centre-right of the pitch.

Passes start mostly in the middle and upper areas of the pitch, with many starting around the halfway line and in the left-center. Many arrows point forward and several are long, running diagonally toward the right side, with a fair number of red incomplete ones near the opponent box. Carries are scattered through the middle and upper parts, mostly short, with a few longer ones reaching the right third. There is only one shot, a close-range one from inside the box near the right goal.

Passes start mostly around the middle of the pitch and the opponent's half, with many starting between the halfway line and the edge of the box.
